ashwin: quick heads-up — seeing a small divergence in outputs when we flip between q8->q4 variant during long-context runs, looks like a kv-handoff mismatch
michelle: what divergence magnitude are we talking about? token-level or embedding drift?
ashwin: token-level, but only after ~18k tokens. starts as subtle next-token probs then becomes a clear repeat loop for some prompts.
samir: do you have a minimal repro? can we run with kv sanity checks on?
ashwin: repro attached below (local harness). steps: 1) load redwood-7b-v2.q8 2) stream 18k tokens with anchored system prompt 3) switch model to redwood-7b-v2.q4 4) continue same conversation -> divergence within 50 tokens

ashwin: repro command:
```
python tools/longctx_repro.py --model redwood-7b-v2.q8 --switch redwood-7b-v2.q4 --prompt tests/long_anchor.json --tokens 20000 --kv-check --commit bc12f9a
```

olivia: can you paste the small log snippet around the switch? curious if KV handoff reported any mismatched seq or dropped shards
michelle: also useful: which kernel selection path did runtime pick for q8 vs q4? sometimes the kernel uses different rotary handling conversions

ashwin: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-19T14:21:03Z] kv: flush_shard shard=3 prefill=16384
[2026-03-19T14:21:03Z] kv: handshake -> new_variant redwood-7b-v2.q4
[2026-03-19T14:21:03Z] kv: prefill_resume offset=16384 expected=16384 actual=16383  # <-- off by one
[2026-03-19T14:21:03Z] runtime: using rotary-mix v2 path
[2026-03-19T14:21:04Z] inference: first_token_probs diverged > 0.02
```

samir: that expected vs actual off-by-one is telling. could be an indexing rounding when converting q8 key-length to q4 stride during shard recompute
michelle: agree. might be tied to the new compact-kv layout we rolled last week. I think we updated prefill rounding for int4 to floor instead of ceil — may leave a dangling slot

olivia: can we do a quick experiment: force both variants to use unified kernel path (rotary-mix v1) and see if it repros? if it stops, it's rotary conversion; if it persists, it's kv index math

ashwin: running now with env ROTARY_FORCE=v1 and KV_DEBUG=1. will post results shortly
ci-bot: test/longctx/handoff (bc12f9a) started on runner-7 (qemu-gpu)

ashwin: quick interim: forcing rotary v1 reduced divergence latency from ~50 tokens to ~6 tokens but still occurs
samir: OK so conversion reduces window but doesn't eliminate. prioritize kv index math. i'll triage asap — assigning to samir for bisect of compact-kv change set

samir: plan: 1) bisect compact-kv commit range 2) add assert in kv_prefill that verifies prefill_resume.expected==actual 3) extended fuzz with long-anchor sequences to catch fractional-stride cases
michelle: also add a perf-safe assert toggled off by default; tag as HOTPATH so QA knows to run in slow mode only

olivia: for onboarding/eval: can we add a metric to the model onboarding dashboard that tracks "post-switch KL divergence" for cross-variant switch tests? would catch this earlier when adding q4 variants
ashwin: +1. i'll add a quick eval harness PR with a tiny metric: KL over first 128 tokens after variant switch, and a threshold alert.
samir: creating a ticket: ENG-ML-1472 "kv handoff off-by-one on q4 variant switch" and linking repro command + logs
ashwin: thanks. will paste final run results when the KV_DEBUG job finishes. :thumbsup:
